name: Stygia
description: With Shem, the Southern Black-Stone Hegemony: riverine empires of the arid southern Tethys rim, snake-worship, obsidian quarries and dark alchemy, holding the trade in Garudasaur marrow moss and resin with slave labour in basalt mines.
notes: A distant power of the Age of Machinery, beyond the edge of the pre-Shattering chart: known in Narmada from trade, telegraph and war, and deliberately given no position.
